questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a school crossing is coming up ahead. Be prepared to slow down or stop for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. It is diamond-shaped with yellow background and black markings. It alerts you that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When riding in a group, a lead rider extends their left arm straight down with palm facing back to signal the group to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Merge. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right. You must slow down to the safe speed shown on the sign (35 mph in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: This is a warning sign with yellow background and black markings. It alerts you to watch for bicycles crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This eight-sided sign means you must stop completely. Yield the right-of-way to other traffic. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow background and black markings. They tell you about hazards or special situations ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign with yellow background and black markings. It alerts you that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a divided highway is starting ahead. The road splits into two one-way sections separated by a median. You must stay in your lane on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that your road is crossing a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median or guide rail.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals are used instead of turn signals. When a rider's left arm is extended straight out to the left, it signals a left turn or left lane change.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This is a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane sign. These lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles carrying a driver plus one or more passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is displaying a red light.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is displaying a green light.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow. They alert you to dangers ahead. This sign means a steep hill is coming. Slow down and adjust your speed to stay safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in groups. This signal means "follow me."

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of a merge ahead. Two lanes of traffic moving in the same direction are about to become one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign showing the highest legal speed allowed on this road. In bad weather or poor conditions, drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs control traffic and enforce rules. This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: When you see this sign, it means that even if you have a green light, you cannot turn left until oncoming traffic has passed through the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: Do not enter from this direction. The road only allows traffic to flow in the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that an upcoming bridge is narrow. You may not be able to safely pass or meet a truck on this bridge. Drive with caution.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: Pedestrians are allowed to cross the road at this location. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a one-way sign. You can only drive in the direction the arrow is pointing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road may be slippery when wet. Reduce your speed and be extra careful during rain or wet conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: A Y-shaped intersection is coming up. Your road splits into two directions. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A steep hill is coming up. Be prepared to shift gears and adjust your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that a T-shaped intersection is ahead. Be ready to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that the road curves ahead. Slow down before you reach the curve.
